mentions.name: PCGaming.ca
mentions.description: A gaming news aggregator that combines a hand-picked set of gaming RSS feeds into a single site (PCGaming.ca) for keeping up with new industry news, supplemented with game deals and affiliate links to help cover web hosting costs.
mentions.problem: Keeping up with what's new in the gaming industry requires following many separate gaming RSS feeds; this consolidates them into one place.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://PCGaming.ca

I follow a bunch of gaming rss feeds just to keep up with what’s new in the industry. Figured I’d take those and turn them into a news aggregator to put them all into one place. Threw in some game deals/affiliate to pay the web hosting bills (hasn’t paid for anything yet, lol).
mentions.author: link7373
